tool: Australis modded aircraft selection regression tests

tests.name: Discovers stock, always-loaded user, enabled local and enabled Workshop aircraft
Does not advertise disabled local or Workshop aircraft
Accepts mod aircraft without squadron files and with unrelated repeated sections
Deduplicates repeated enabled root entries without duplicate aircraft
Refuses unresolved enabled Workshop roots instead of publishing an incomplete catalogue
Refuses traversal in enabled local mod directory
Refuses ambiguous enabled Workshop mod found in two Steam libraries
Changes only the whitelist line and preserves embarked/custom IDs
Rejects duplicate FlightDeck or repeated whitelist keys
Repeated catalogue refresh discovers newly added mod aircraft
Check mode does not change any game files
Install, later refresh, conflict refusal and both restore transactions execute against real files
Restores interrupted transactions containing a mix of before and after file states
Preserves UTF-8 BOM and UTF-16 little-endian encoding through install and exact-byte restore

test_runtime: PowerShell 7.4.6 / Linux isolated filesystem fixtures; Windows PowerShell 5.1-compatible source
launcher_payload_validation: All three launcher payloads hash-match their source; embedded PowerShell AST checked separately.
